sentences.text: For Respondent(s) : Mr. Arun Kumar, PP  HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE KULDEEP MATHUR Order 19/01/2023 This application for bail under Section 439 Cr.P.C. has been filed by the petitioner who has been arrested in connection with FIR No.227/2022 registered at Police Station Gangasahar, District Bikaner, for offence under Section 376 (2) (n) of IPC.
Heard learned counsel for the petitioner as also the learned Public Prosecutor and perused the statement of the prosecutrix recorded under Section 164 Cr.P.C. before the competent criminal court.
Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that no alleged videos or photographs have been recovered from the petitioner.
He further submits that a false case has been foisted against the petitioner.
He has nothing to do with the alleged offences and no useful purpose would be served by keeping him behind the bars.
Per contra, learned Public Prosecutor opposed the bail application.

Considering the arguments advanced by the counsel for the parties and looking to the possibility that the trial may take long time to conclude, this court deems it just and proper to enlarge the petitioner on bail.

Accordingly, the bail application under Section 439 Cr.P.C. is allowed and it is ordered that the accused-petitioner-Suresh Chandra S/o Panna Lal shall be enlarged on bail provided he furnishes a Suresh Chandra vs State Of Rajasthan on 19 January, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/169745635/
